_about: Thresholds for eval/gate.py. A pull request that touches the RAG code must stay inside them. Raise them as the system improves; runs vary by about 2-3 questions, so leave that much room.
_reference: Original build: fast mode 25/39 correct, 6 wrong, 2 refused, refusal accuracy 1.0; citation accuracy 95%; safety 16/16; guard 0/45 golden questions blocked. Lower the thresholds if you change models or the test set, raise them as quality improves.
